crossRefs.note: Abraham was old, and well advanced in age. Yahweh had blessed Abraham in all things.
I will make of you a great nation. I will bless you and make your name great. You will be a blessing.
Abram was very rich in livestock, in silver, and in gold.
After the death of Abraham, God blessed Isaac, his son. Isaac lived by Beer Lahai Roi.
Isaac sowed in that land, and reaped in the same year one hundred times what he planted. Yahweh blessed him.
even by the God of your father, who will help you, by the Almighty, who will bless you, with blessings of heaven above…
You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your right hand sustains me. Your gentleness has made me great.
Wealth and riches are in his house. His righteousness endures forever.
Yahweh’s blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.
The result of humility and the fear of Yahweh is wealth, honor, and life.
For bodily exercise has some value, but godliness has value in all things, having the promise of the life which is now…
He dealt well with Abram for her sake. He had sheep, cattle, male donkeys, male servants, female servants, female…
Abram was very rich in livestock, in silver, and in gold.
The man grew great, and grew more and more until he became very great.
He had possessions of flocks, possessions of herds, and a great household. The Philistines envied him.
His possessions also were seven thousand sheep, three thousand camels, five hundred yoke of oxen, five hundred female…
Yahweh turned the captivity of Job, when he prayed for his friends. Yahweh gave Job twice as much as he had before.
He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly. He doesn’t allow their livestock to decrease.
But seek first God’s Kingdom, and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.

translations.web: Yahweh has blessed my master greatly. He has become great. Yahweh has given him flocks and herds, silver and gold, male servants and female servants, and camels and donkeys.
translations.bsb: “The LORD has greatly blessed my master, and he has become rich. He has given him sheep and cattle, silver and gold, menservants and maidservants, camels and donkeys.
translations.kjv: And the LORD hath blessed my master greatly; and he is become great: and he hath given him flocks, and herds, and silver, and gold, and menservants, and maidservants, and camels, and asses.
translations.asv: And Jehovah hath blessed my master greatly. And he is become great. And he hath given him flocks and herds, and silver and gold, and men-servants and maid-servants, and camels and asses.
